title: feat(plugin-list,plugin-view,types,app-shell)!: retire the filterableFields Filter-panel whitelist reader (objectui#13118)
body:
Fixes #13118

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What

`@objectstack/spec` 18 retires the list view's `filterableFields` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24640, maintainer ruling 「C」, record 6278975049; pulled into 18.0 by 「提前」, record 6279033298). No per-view Filter-panel whitelist replaces it: the Filter panel offers every field the user may read, minus the fields the object marks `hidden: true`. This PR removes objectui's readers of the key.

- **Renderer** (`@object-ui/plugin-list`). The `filterFields` memo in `ListView` drops the whitelist branch and the `!!whitelist` exemption for hidden fields, and the memo's deps drop `schema.filterableFields`. The no-whitelist branch already offered every readable field minus `hidden` ones, so a view without the key sees no change. A hidden field still appears when a condition the panel holds filters on it (objectui#11810's rule, unchanged).
- **Relays**. The `object-view` delegation in `@object-ui/plugin-view` stops forwarding the key from all three sources (named view, host `views` entry, node), and `OBJECT_VIEW_DECLARED_FORWARDED_KEYS` drops it (31 node reads become 30: 27 host-composition plus 3 declared). The `@object-ui/app-shell` object page stops relaying it off the active view. The `object-view` registration stops publishing it as an input.
- **Types** (`@object-ui/types`). `NamedListView.filterableFields` is a `?: never` tombstone. `ObjectViewSchema.filterableFields` is deprecated and typed by reference to the list view's spec-derived slot, the slot its zod twin already carries; see H2 for why it is not a tombstone yet.
- **Zod mirror**. The by-reference line `filterableFields: stripImportedDefaults(SpecListViewSchema).shape.filterableFields` stays, as the card prescribes; only its comments changed (H3).
- **Docs**. The `ObjectViewSchema` example in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` stops teaching the key; `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx` and `packages/plugin-view/README.md` stop listing it.
- **Changeset**. `.changeset/13118-retire-filterable-fields.md`: `minor` for `plugin-list`, `plugin-view`, `types`, `app-shell`, with the BREAKING paragraph and its remedy (delete the key; for a curated end-user filter bar, author `userFilters`). The `Clause-②` line above is the claim's, and the delivered diff still matches it: it accepts nothing new and narrows the published surface (the registration input, the `NamedListView` member, the renderer behaviour).

## The PM's hypotheses, measured

**H1 — confirmed.** The renderer change is the card's own. Tests that asserted the whitelist now assert the spec's prescription; none was deleted.
- No-key behaviour does not move: the objectui#11810 row "offers no hidden field, and orders columns, other business fields, system fields" is unchanged and green at the head, and green with the whitelist branch put back (the ablation below runs BASE's memo logic).
- The removal is pinned by four rows that a stored view still carrying the key exercises: `ListView.filterFieldList-11810` (the spec's list, no hidden field brought back), `ListView.filterFieldRead-11925` (the read-checked list, no narrower and no wider), `ListView.sortFieldFallback` (the inverted control: the filter builder offers every field) and `ListViewBlock.specInputs-13047` (through the real `SchemaRenderer` page node: "Add filter" starts on `Name` with or without the key).
- Ablation, one shot, committed fix first: `ablation-replace.mjs` put the whitelist branch back into the memo's filter by a literal anchor (anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1 on disk, blob changed), ran the four files, and restored (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). Result: exactly the four rows red, 66 green. The failures read: `expected [ 'title', 'estimate_hours', …(1) ] to not include 'owning_business_unit_id'`; `expected [ 'title', 'priority' ] to deeply equal [ 'title', 'status', 'priority' ]`; `Unable to find an element with the text: Name`; `expected 'Amount' to be 'Name'`. No permanent ablation file was left.

**H2 — measured per parity test, at objectui's pin `f4755a68`.** Every one stays, none is skipped.
- `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779`: models the key with the file's own mechanism, a named bucket pinned exactly, after objectui#12030's PENDING precedent. A sixth bucket, `BUCKET_SPEC_RETIRED_AHEAD_OF_PIN = ['filterableFields']`, holds a key the installed protocol still calls live and objectstack `main` retires. It is self-expiring: its row asserts the installed spec does not carry the tombstone yet, so the pin bump reddens it with the instruction to move the key into `PROTOCOL_RETIRED_KEYS` and `BUCKET_PROTOCOL_RETIRED_TOMBSTONED`. The node-level read pins for the key are inverted, not deleted; the named-view census moves from 43 read plus 22 unread to 42 plus 23 (65 declared, unchanged).
- `registry-inputs-spec-parity` (console): the existing `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` entry for `list-view.filterableFields` keeps its slot with a true reason; it goes stale on its own at the pin that carries the tombstone.
- `object-view-spec-parity`: green unchanged in mechanics (TS and zod both still declare the key); its `SPEC_COUNTERPART` note is updated.
- `zod-mirror-parity`: green with no change, because of the next point.
- ⚠️ **Deviation, reported:** a local `?: never` tombstone on `ObjectViewSchema` was tried first and measured red. `node-recursion-point-8344` (types `type-check`, TS2344) reads every zod arm's output against the TS node union, and the `object-view` arm became a new drifted arm against the by-reference zod slot, which still admits `string[]` at the pin. That ratchet says not to add a name to make a red go away, so the node's member is typed by reference to the same spec slot instead: both faces flip to the spec's tombstone at the pin bump, with nothing to edit there. `NamedListView` has no zod twin, so its tombstone holds now.

**H3 — confirmed.** The zod line stays. Under objectstack `main`'s spec (the H4 green leg below), `@object-ui/types` builds, so leaving the by-reference line compiles there.

**H4 — reproduced, red then green.** In a scratch objectstack worktree at `origin/main` `580fd4ed3c98` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor 4bc3becd5f HEAD` answered 0), after `pnpm run setup`, with `.objectui-sha` edited locally and never committed, `OBJECTUI_ROOT=/home/user/objectui-issue-13118 bash scripts/build-console.sh` under the verify lock:
- at BASE `ed2805768b32`: exit 1, `@object-ui/plugin-list#build` failed with exactly two errors in `src/ListView.tsx`, TS2339 (`Property 'length' does not exist on type` the spec's `[REMOVED]` brand) and TS2769 (no `Set` constructor overload matches it);
- at this head `05d46fed0a2b`: exit 0. The bundle canary, the single-zod canary and the spec-injection assertion all pass; the dist is ready. The script's notice that the tracked `sdui.manifest.json` records a different objectui SHA is the objectstack pin bump's to regenerate.
- The scratch worktree and the two objectui build worktrees the script registered were removed afterwards (node_modules first, `git worktree remove` without `--force`, both clean).

## Gates, at head `05d46fe`

- `type-check` for `types`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-view`, `app-shell` and `console`: exit 0 at `416ec6c`, after building the console's dependency closure at objectui's pin (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^...`, 34 tasks). A per-package `type-check` without that closure answers TS2307 for every sibling package: not measured, not red. The one later commit, `05d46fe`, restores two blank lines in `objectql.ts`; `types` and `plugin-list` `type-check` were re-run on it, exit 0.
- `lint` for the same five packages: exit 0, 0 errors, at `416ec6c`. Per changed file, the eslint findings at the head equal BASE's count or fall below it.
- Targeted tests, 18 files (the touched test files, the four parity tests, `node-recursion-point-8344`), re-run on `05d46fe`: 18 files, 937 tests passed.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0 each.
- Full package suites and the rest of the farm are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Shared files.** `domain:ui#2` holds objectui#13116 in `ListView.tsx` (the `$select` harvest) and objectui#13114 in the app-shell `ObjectView.tsx` (the tab bar and the chart branch). This diff stays in the `filterFields` memo and its docblocks, and in the one relay line of the app-shell file. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
- **Test files beyond the claim's census.** Two files that never spelled the key had to move with the reader: `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559` (a new `unread` answer, the `striped` precedent) and, per its own instruction to delete a stale entry in the same change, `InterfaceListPage.relayCensus-11572`. `node-recursion-point-8344` is unchanged and was measured.
- **Left alone on purpose.** `SchemaForm.topLevelUnion-11251` (the spec's own view form at the pin still offers the key), `objectView-config-keys-retired-4730` (a locale-key record), `ObjectView.specShapedNamedView-8254` (history), `ROADMAP.md` and `docs/audits/**` (dated records). All green or untouched.
- **What the pin bump that takes `4bc3becd5f` will meet.** Each announces itself by name: the self-expiring bucket in `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779`; the `SPEC_COUNTERPART` anchor in `object-view-spec-parity`; the console's `list-view.filterableFields` exemption going stale; and the `ObjectViewSchema` member, which narrows with no edit because it is typed by reference.
- **Observation, not filed (no carrier).** objectstack's `scripts/build-console.sh` checks `OBJECTUI_ROOT` with a directory test on `.git`. A linked worktree's `.git` is a file, so the override is skipped and the script falls back to the sibling `../objectui` checkout ("Using objectui source at /home/user/objectui" in both legs above). Here the two share one object store, so the SHA resolved and both readings stand.
